name: claude-vault-capture
description: Automatically turns Claude Code sessions into curated Obsidian notes. On SessionEnd a backgrounded worker scrubs secrets, sends the transcript to a model, and writes a decision/runbook/gotcha/spec to your vault's Inbox/auto/. Makes a paid model call per qualifying session (~$0.13 median, or bill it to a Claude Pro/Max plan). Includes the /vault-save skill for on-demand exports.

vault_dir.title: Obsidian vault path
vault_dir.description: Absolute path to the ROOT of your Obsidian vault (the folder containing .obsidian/), not a subfolder. Captures are written to <vault>/Inbox/auto/ and /vault-save exports to <vault>/claude-docs/; both are created if missing — so a mistyped path fails silently by making new folders somewhere else.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: API key for metered (default) mode. REQUIRED unless you set 'Bill to Claude subscription' below — with neither, every capture aborts before the model call and writes no note and no log entry. Note that Claude Code strips the environment it runs hooks in, so an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exported in your shell profile usually does NOT reach the worker; set it here (stored in your OS keychain) or in ~/.claude_vault_token (which must be chmod 600, or the hook refuses it).

use_subscription.title: Bill to Claude subscription
use_subscription.description: Set to 1 to bill model calls to your Claude Pro/Max subscription instead of a metered API key. Requires the `claude` CLI installed and an OAuth token below. Captures then draw on the same rolling rate limit as your interactive usage, and the logged cost becomes an estimate rather than a billed amount.

oauth_token.title: Claude OAuth token (subscription mode)
oauth_token.description: Long-lived token from `claude setup-token` (starts with sk-ant-oat01-…). Required when 'Bill to Claude subscription' is 1. Stored in your OS keychain. Alternative: ~/.claude_vault_oauth_token, which must be chmod 600 or the hook refuses it.

timeout_seconds.title: Model call timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Hard wall in seconds on a single model call; leave blank for 30. Raise it (120 is a reasonable ceiling) if large sessions log skip_reason 'timeout' — all model work is backgrounded, so a higher value never delays session close. Positive whole number.

max_est_tokens.title: Token ceiling before skipping
max_est_tokens.description: Sessions estimated above this many tokens are skipped un-captured; leave blank for 50000 (~200 KB of transcript). Raise it if long sessions log skip_reason 'token_limit'. Positive whole number.

excluded_commands.title: Excluded slash commands
excluded_commands.description: Comma-separated slash commands whose sessions are never captured, e.g. /daily-devlog,/weekly-recap. Matched when typed as a command (or at the start of a line), so mentions in prose don't count. Leave blank to capture every qualifying session.
